headline: Anthropic's chief executive Dario Amodei was paid about $18 million for 2025, according to the company's filing for a stock-market listing.
score_reason: Reuters exclusive from the S-1 filing; read through the New York Post.
importance_line: It gives the public a first look at how a leading AI lab pays its founders, though almost all of the pay is stock and the filing does not say how many shares he owns.
summary: Reuters reports, as relayed by the New York Post, that the figure comes from Anthropic's S-1 prospectus (the document filed to go public), a copy of which Reuters obtained, and that most of it is stock and options, since his salary was $1.4 million. Courtney Yu of pay-data firm Equilar told Reuters the total 'seems on the lower end for a company valued at $2 trillion', and the filing does not detail how many shares he owns.
notes: Reuters page blocked; read the New York Post's account of the Reuters exclusive. The $2 trillion valuation is from the Post's text ('expected to fetch'), not confirmed by us.
